name: llama.cpp
description: llama-server: the servers running on this Mac and the GGUF models downloaded for them; start a server, open its page, start Claude Code on it.

settings.title: llama-server
settings.description: Its name on PATH, or its full path if you built llama.cpp yourself.

badge.command: pgrep -f '(^|/)llama-server( |$)' | while read -r p; do ps -o comm= -p $(ps -o ppid= -p $p) | grep -qvE 'kelpd|ollama' && echo; done | wc -l | tr -d ' ' | grep -v '^0$'

list.command:
hub=$HOME/.cache/huggingface/hub
[[ -n $HF_HOME ]] && hub=$HF_HOME/hub
[[ -n $HF_HUB_CACHE ]] && hub=$HF_HUB_CACHE
gb() { jq -nr --argjson b $1 'if $b >= 1e9 then "\($b / 1e8 | round / 10) GB" else "\($b / 1e6 | round) MB" end'; }
served=()
for pid in $(pgrep -f '(^|/)llama-server( |$)'); do
  args=$(ps -o args= -p $pid)
  port=$(lsof -nP -a -p $pid -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -Fn 2>/dev/null | sed -nE 's/^n.*:([0-9]+)$/\1/p' | head -1)
  owner=$(ps -o comm= -p $(ps -o ppid= -p $pid))
  [[ $owner == */ollama || $owner == ollama ]] && continue   # Ollama's own runner: the Ollama panel shows it
  props=null slots=null
  if [[ -n $port ]]; then
    props=$(curl -sf -m 1 http://127.0.0.1:$port/props) || props=null
    slots=$(curl -sf -m 1 http://127.0.0.1:$port/slots) || slots=null
  fi
  file=$(print -r -- $props | jq -r '.model_path // empty')
  [[ -n $file ]] && served+=$file:A
  size=0; [[ -f $file ]] && size=$(stat -Lf %z $file)
  jq -nc --arg pid $pid --arg port $port --arg file "$file" --arg size "$( (( size > 0 )) && gb $size)" --arg owner "$owner" \
    --argjson props "$props" --argjson slots "$slots" '
    ($owner | test("kelpd")) as $kelp
    | {kind: "server", server: true, cached: false, stoppable: ($kelp | not), pid: $pid, port: $port, file: $file, kelp: $kelp, state: "running", icon: "server.rack",
       title: ($file | split("/") | last // "" | sub("\\.gguf$"; "") | if . == "" then "llama-server" else . end),
       subtitle: ([ (if $kelp then "Kelp · next edit" else empty end),
                    ($slots | if type == "array" and any(.[]; .is_processing) then "Answering" else empty end),
                    (if $port == "" then "Starting…" else "Port \($port)" end),
                    ($props.default_generation_settings.n_ctx // $props.n_ctx // empty | "\(. / 1024 | floor)K context")
                    ] | join(" · "))}'
done
find $hub -path '*/snapshots/*' -name '*.gguf' ! -name 'mmproj*' 2>/dev/null | sort | while read -r f; do
  print -rl -- $served | grep -qxF -- $f:A && continue
  repo=$(print -r -- $f | sed -E 's|.*/models--([^/]*)--([^/]*)/snapshots/.*|\1/\2|')
  jq -nc --arg file $f --arg repo $repo --arg size "$(gb $(stat -Lf %z $f))" '
    {kind: "file", server: false, cached: true, stoppable: false, pid: "", port: "", file: $file, kelp: false, state: "file", icon: "doc",
     title: ($file | split("/") | last | sub("\\.gguf$"; "")), subtitle: "\($size) · \($repo | sub("-GGUF$"; ""))"}'
done
list.title: ${title}
list.subtitle: ${subtitle}

actions.title: Start Server
actions.terminal: p=8080; while nc -z 127.0.0.1 $p 2>/dev/null; do p=$((p+1)); done; ${setting:llamacpp.server} -m "$KELP_file" --jinja -c 32768 --port $p

toolbar.title: Download Model…
toolbar.terminal: p=8080; while nc -z 127.0.0.1 $p 2>/dev/null; do p=$((p+1)); done; printf "Model on Hugging Face (user/repo:quant): "; read -r m && [ -n "$m" ] && ${setting:llamacpp.server} -hf "$m" --jinja -c 32768 --port $p

toolbar.title: Find GGUF Models on Hugging Face
